settings.entry: Buy stop at the pivot, valid 5 sessions after the setup day
settings.stop: Structural stop clamped to 3%-8% below the fill
settings.exit: First close below the 50-day SMA (21-day EMA once a close is 20%+ above the fill), or session 252
settings.sizing: 1% account risk per trade, position capped at 25%
settings.idle_cash: Idle cash: held in SPY while SPY is above its 200-day SMA (to cash below -3%, back above +3%)
settings.signal: Each setup (ticker, setup day, family) counts once

idle_cash.text: Idle cash: held in SPY while SPY is above its 200-day SMA (to cash below -3%, back above +3%)
idle_cash.note: 2026-10 study: parking idle cash in SPY while SPY is above its 200-day SMA (3% band) raised the walk-forward record of the selection procedure from 8.6% to 10.8-12.2%/yr (2010-2026; SPY 12.0%; the range depends on when SPY is sold to fund a fill) and F6b 2007-2026 from 11.9% to 14.7-16.0%/yr with about the same max drawdown (22-23%). Bands of 1-5% gave similar results.
